# MyBingoCard

> MyBingoCard is a free bingo card generator for printable and online bingo games. People use it to create custom bingo cards for classrooms, baby showers, weddings, holidays, team building, birthday parties, and other events.

## What MyBingoCard Does

- Create custom bingo cards with your own words or images
- Generate printable bingo cards as PDF files
- Share bingo cards online with unique links
- Host live multiplayer bingo games with real-time number calling
- Choose from themed templates for baby showers, weddings, classrooms, parties, holidays, and office events
- Use 3x3, 4x4, or 5x5 grid sizes
- Use AI to generate bingo card ideas and cell text
- Batch generate up to 500 unique cards at once

## Pricing

- Free: create bingo cards online, use starter templates, export standard PDFs, includes ads
- Premium Monthly: $4.99/month
- Premium Lifetime: $14.99 one-time
- Signup is free, no credit card required

## Use Cases

- Teachers: vocabulary review, math facts, spelling, classroom rewards
- Baby showers: gift prediction bingo, baby item bingo
- Weddings: reception bingo, bridal shower bingo
- Parties: holiday parties, birthday parties, game nights
- Corporate: team building, icebreakers, onboarding, all-hands meetings
- Senior centers: activity bingo for elderly residents
- ESL/language learning: vocabulary bingo in any language
- Health & wellness: nutrition bingo, fitness bingo

## How It Works

1. Go to https://mybingocard.com/create
2. Add your own words, phrases, or images
3. Choose a grid size and template
4. Print a PDF, share a link, or host a live game online
